catalogue.name: The Enclaves
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: United
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Window through the Maelstrom: the attack of one (1) friendly unit gets indirect until end of turn.
● Scorch Aarth: one (1) terrain feature that grants cover gets Cover(-1) until end of game.
● Cursed Steel: the attack of one (1) enemy unit becomes hazardous until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Ignores difficult terrain for CC attacks
Fateweawing Mystic(3x2)
sharedRules.description:
When activated, may roll level number of dice and pick one (1) available power from school mystic list. If you get several dice at target level, you may use boosted version. Also apply all results of ‘1’.

Example: Player A rolls ‘1’,’1’,’5’ and may select a 5+ or worse power from the applicable school. Player A also applies the boosted version of the ‘1’ result.

sharedRules.name: Icon of the Old Gods
sharedRules.description: One (1) friendly unit (per turn) deploying with insertion within 12” of this model arrives with one (1) less action marker.

sharedRules.name: Mark of Anger
sharedRules.description:
The unit can use The Dogs of War Faction power once for free.

The Dogs of War: use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: Mark of Insight
sharedRules.description:
The unit can use the Maelstrom Rift power once for free.

Maelstrom Rift: one (1) friendly regular unit gets Move(teleport) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Mark of Ecxess
sharedRules.description:
The unit can use the Instil Doubt power once for free.

Instil Doubt: one (1) enemy unit gets hit(potshots) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Mark of Sickness
sharedRules.description:
The unit can use the Beware us from the Sickness! power once for free.

Beware us from the Sickness!: use when a CC attack is made vs a friendly unit. It gets Repel(2) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Sickness
sharedRules.description:
1x Sworn Soldiers(Sickness) or Maelstrom Entities(Sickness) does not count as a special choice.

May not use Sworn Soldiers, Maelstrom Entities or Favour upgrades other than Sickness.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● “They won’t go down!!”: use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a friendly regular unit. It has Defence(re- roll) for this attack.
● “Beware us from the Sickness!”: use when a CC attack is made vs a friendly unit. It gets Repel(2) until end of turn.
● “Keep your distance!”: a friendly unit attacks with 6” (1), blast, pistol, ignore cover as a free action. If the attack causes any wounds, attack another unit within 6” of the target with cumulative wound(-1). A unit can be attacked by this power max 1/turn.

sharedRules.name: Insight
sharedRules.description:
1x Sworn Soldiers(Insight) or Maelstrom Entities(Insight) does not count as a special choice.

May not use Sworn Soldiers, Maelstrom Entities or Favour upgrades other than Insight.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Sorcery from Beyond: one (1) friendly regular model gets Mystic(Dark Arts 2) until end of turn.
● Plans within plans: use when determining initiative. If you would have it, your opponent gets it instead. Alternatively, use it as the “Snatch the Initiative” FP option, but retain your FP on 5+.
● Maelstrom Rift: one (1) friendly regular unit gets Move(teleport) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Excess
sharedRules.description:
1x Sworn Soldiers(Excess) or Maelstrom Entities(Excess) does not count as a special choice.

May not use Sworn Soldiers, Maelstrom Entities or Favour upgrades other than Excess.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Impart secrets: use when an enemy unit deploys with Infiltrate or Vanguard. It gets two (2) action markers.
● Inflame Passion: one (1) regular enemy unit gets Fanatic until end of turn.
● Instil Doubt: one (1) enemy unit gets hit(potshots) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Anger
sharedRules.description:
1x Sworn Soldiers(Anger) or Maelstrom Entities(Anger) does not count as a special choice.

May not use Sworn Soldiers, Maelstrom Entities or Favour upgrades other than Anger.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Cry Havoc: the CC attack of one (1) friendly unit gets vicious until end of turn.
● Let Slip: all friendly Enclave APCs gets Capacity(assault) and Charge(nimble) until end of turn.
● The Dogs of War: use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: Herald of the Maelstrom
sharedRules.description: This model’s unit count only half its wounds(round up) as Unstable.

sharedRules.name: Inflict Defence(-1) (18”, closest vehicle only)
sharedRules.description: Models of closest enemy vehicle within 18" has Defence(-1). If a unit already has trait at a worse level, this takes precedence.
